quotes.name: Vinnie Keane
quotes.quote: I feel like we're really coming together as a team, and I'm seeing some great performances from my teammates, it's an exciting time to be an A's player.

quotes.name: Mark Aitken
quotes.quote: I've been feeling the energy around the A's late-season game, and I think our key players have really been stepping up - it's exciting to see them perform at this level.

quotes.name: Benji Dillon
quotes.quote: I feel like we're all coming together as a team, and it's showing in our performances - I'm proud of how we're playing, and I think we've got a good shot at keeping this streak going.

quotes.name: Isley Kelley
quotes.quote: I've seen our team really come together late in the season, with key players stepping up and making big plays - it's been exciting to watch and be a part of. I feel like we're all feeding off each other's energy and it's showing in our performance.

claim: I feel like we're really coming together as a team, and I'm seeing some great performances from my teammates, it's an exciting time to be an A's player.
